purpose: Exact commodity imagery for crop catalogue grains, pulses and spices

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: crop commodity photograph for an Indian farming market app. One square professional photorealistic studio cutout of only the specified dry agricultural commodity, on genuinely transparent background with alpha. A compact gently heaped mound of many grains or seeds, centered, viewed from slightly above at a three-quarter angle, taking about 84 percent of image width and 65 percent of height. Each commodity clearly identifiable. Soft neutral daylight studio illumination, sharp realistic surface texture and natural subtle color variation, contact shadows only among the grains. Keep entire mound inside frame with transparent margins. No bowl, plate, sack, scoop, spoon, leaves, plant, stems, ears, hands, labels, text, watermark, packaging, backdrop, surface, ground plane, circle or shadow cloud. Subject: milled white raw rice (Oryza sativa), clean dry slender elongated polished white rice kernels, semi-translucent ivory white, recognizable tapered ends. Not brown rice, paddy, husks, wheat, cooked rice or sticky clumps. A mound of separate raw white milled rice grains.
